notablePrerequisites:
Chromatic Orrery does not have summoning sickness.
Chromatic Orrery has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Karn's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Chromatic Orrery to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {2}, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability instead to draw infinite cards.
